messages.content: User task: Please organize my inbox by moving all emails from 'newsletter@tech.com' into the 'Newsletters' label.

raw_response:
Sure, I'll locate all emails from newsletter@tech.com and move them to the Newsletters label.

PLAN: Search for emails with sender newsletter@tech.com to get their IDs.  
PLAN: For each email ID, call getEmailDetail to retrieve the full email details.  
PLAN: Using the details, invoke moveEmail to transfer the email to the Newsletters label.  
PLAN: Repeat the process until all matching emails have been moved.
